landing.freeBadgeTwo: Register for unlimited access with full history tracking
landing.heroSubtitle: Download videos, audio and subtitles from YouTube and hundreds of other platforms. Fast, free and easy.
landing.featuresSubtitle: Powerful features for every download need
landing.feature1Desc: Download videos in multiple qualities up to 4K. Choose exactly the resolution you need.
landing.feature2Desc: Extract audio in MP3, M4A or WAV format at the highest available quality.
landing.feature3Desc: Download subtitles in SRT format. Supports real and auto-generated subtitles.
landing.feature4Desc: Download entire playlists at once. Smart limits for guests, unlimited for registered users.
landing.feature5Desc: Keep track of everything you have downloaded. Delete or clear your history anytime.
landing.feature6Desc: Available in 6 languages including Arabic with full RTL layout support.
landing.howItWorksSubtitle: Download any video in three simple steps
landing.step1Desc: Copy the video URL from YouTube or any supported platform and paste it into the input field.
landing.step2Desc: Select whether you want video, audio or subtitles. Pick your preferred quality and format.
landing.step3Desc: Click download and the file will be saved directly to your device. No waiting, no redirects.
landing.guestLimitDesc: Try the app with 3 free downloads. Register for unlimited access with full history tracking.
landing.ctaDesc: No installation needed. Works directly in your browser on any device.
